name: mnemonic_chrono_tear
label: Memory Chrono-Tear
godotFeature: ShaderMaterial with vertex displacement & dynamic CollisionShape3D modification
poeticVision: Feel the desperate urgency as the very fabric of time within a memory tears around you. Objects, platforms, and even crucial memory fragments flicker into non-existence, then violently snap back, but never quite the same. It's not just decay; it's a frantic, unpredictable struggle against a reality that cannot decide what it *is*, forcing split-second decisions to grab what remains before it's gone for good, or be swallowed by the void of forgetfulness. The world itself is having a seizure of temporal confusion.

parameters.name: tear_shader_path
parameters.description: Path to the Chrono-Tear shader resource file (.gdshader).

parameters.name: flicker_interval
parameters.description: Time in seconds between collision state changes (on/off) for affected objects.

parameters.name: tear_intensity
parameters.description: Overall intensity of the visual tear effect (0.0-1.0). Higher values mean more aggressive tearing.

parameters.name: tear_speed
parameters.description: Speed of the internal noise animation within the shader, contributing to the visual chaos.

parameters.name: noise_texture
parameters.description: A NoiseTexture resource used by the shader for vertex displacement and alpha clipping patterns.

verdict: In the fractured echoes of time, Lyra will find her resolve tested, her very existence a fleeting whisper against the Silence's ravenous maw.
impact: The player will experience constant, visceral tension. Every step through a Chrono-Tear zone becomes a calculated risk, a frantic dance between solid ground and the void. It forces immediate, high-stakes decision-making, transforming environmental traversal into a desperate struggle against the very fabric of reality, directly embodying the theme of identity dissolving and memories crumbling.
